items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] this was a place that I went and heard Richard Batiste... [INTERVIEWEE] well tradition can get started very easily yeah

ctx.x: I don't even remember Dutchess yeah

this was a place that I went and heard Richard Batiste who was a trumpet player who at times sounded a lot like bunk but didn't know who bunk was one of those things yeah yeah I think there were certain things that uh they'd make a trill with the metal valve on the trumpet that bunk would be on a record and we were all impressed and we saw Richard Batiste do the same thing and maybe it was a new woman's tradition there were a lot of things that were traditional that I'm sure came from people like somebody petite…
well tradition can get started very easily yeah
